name.local: 関西スタートアップアカデミア・コアリション（KSAC）

aka: 関西スタートアップアカデミアコアリション

strategy.thesis: JST-funded Kansai-region academia-driven startup-ecosystem platform of 70+ universities, companies, financial institutions and governments (Kyoto University, Osaka University, Kobe University and others), operating the KSAC-GAP Fund to commercialize university research and continuously create university-origin startups.

investment.raw: KSAC-GAP Fund R&D grants (non-equity); amount per project undisclosed

program.eligibility: Researchers at KSAC member universities with commercialization/global-expansion potential.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to KSAC-GAP Fund calls via member universities.

summary.en: JST-funded Kansai academia-driven startup ecosystem coalition of 70+ institutions led by Kyoto, Osaka and Kobe universities (and others). Operates the KSAC-GAP Fund providing non-equity R&D grants to commercialize university research and grow the regional base of university-origin startups.

name.en: JST START — Program for Creating Startups from Advanced Research and Technology
name.local: JST 大学発新産業創出プログラム（START）

aka: 大学発新産業創出プログラム

strategy.thesis: National-government program run by the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) that funds the commercialization of university/research-institute research seeds, including GAP-fund grants and the university-ecosystem (startup-ecosystem co-creation) platforms such as GTIE and KSAC.

investment.raw: GAP-fund R&D grants (non-equity) for PoC/prototyping/business-model refinement; amounts vary by track

program.eligibility: Researchers at participating universities/research institutions with commercializable research seeds; ecosystem platforms led by consortia of universities.

application.how_to_apply: Apply through JST public calls or via consortium platforms (GTIE, KSAC, PARKS, etc.).

summary.en: JST START is Japan's national government program (since 2012, run by the Japan Science and Technology Agency) for creating startups from university and research-institute seeds. It provides GAP-fund R&D grants and funds the regional university-ecosystem platforms (GTIE, KSAC, PARKS and others) under the 大学発新産業創出基金事業.
summary.local: JST『大学発新産業創出プログラム（START）』は、文科省所管のJSTが運営する国の事業（2012年〜）。大学・研究機関の研究成果の事業化を、GAPファンドや大学エコシステム形成支援（GTIE・KSAC等）で支援する。

name.en: GRIP JAPAN — Keihanshin Asia Acceleration Program
name.local: 京阪神アジアアクセラレーションプログラム（GRIP JAPAN）

strategy.thesis: JETRO + Kyoto University + National University of Singapore (NUS) accelerator adapting NUS's national GRIP program for Japanese universities — the first time NUS's GRIP targets Japan — to commercialize early-stage deep-tech research seeds into internationally competitive startups.

program.eligibility: Pre-incorporation deep-tech research seeds from Kyoto University (first edition).

application.how_to_apply: Selection of Kyoto University research seeds via JETRO / Kyoto University; not an open cold-inbound call.

summary.en: GRIP JAPAN (Keihanshin Asia Acceleration Program) is a deep-tech accelerator launched by JETRO with Kyoto University and the National University of Singapore — the first application of NUS's national GRIP program to Japanese universities. The ~4-month first edition (Nov 2025–Mar 2026) supports four pre-incorporation Kyoto University research seeds.
summary.local: JETRO・京都大学・シンガポール国立大学（NUS）による『京阪神アジアアクセラレーションプログラム（GRIP JAPAN）』。NUSのGRIPを日本の大学向けに初実施。約4か月（2025年11月〜2026年3月）で京都大学の4シーズを支援。

sources.title: ジェトロが創業前のシーズを事業化するプログラムを京都大学と開始
sources.supports: Partners, deep-tech focus, ~4-month duration, 4 Kyoto University seeds, first-in-Japan NUS GRIP
sources.quote: 京阪神アジアアクセラレーションプログラム(GRIP JAPAN) … 京都大学が有する４つのシーズ（プロジェクト）を対象に選定 … 2025年11月17日 … 2026年3月9日 … 同プログラムが日本の大学を対象にするのは初めて
